body:
I started smoking meth when I was 13. I had tried many drugs before it including acid and cocaine and was just looking for that longer high than coke brought me. The first time I smoked was with tin foil and a hollowed out straw. It was great. After that I did it on occasion trying many different forms of it (lily,old school,etc.).
At one point in my life I remember being addicted to it and that was when I was 15 years old. I had been on the run and was living in a party house where it was constantly available. I had done many inconceivable things like selling my foster sister to a couple navy guys just to get a 20 bag per favor. After that night we got busted while we were with a big dealer in a stolen van. We were chased by 9 police vehicles and wound up being on the news that night.
When the doors closed on my cell that night I recall this feeling of needing to crawl out of my skin. Every time I closed my eyes all I could see was the glass dick and the bitter melted liquid rolling around in the bowl, the smoke coming out of the freshly melted liquid. I was so sick but I couldnt puke. I was shaking uncontrollably screaming and needing more. It was hell. I ended up doing it again on occasion and never feeling that addicting twinge after that. Eventually the drug just stopped working for me. The intense feelings of speedy euphoria turned into nothing but the long lasting intense feelings of paranoia instead. I haven't done it in a month and don't really ever feel the need to. Sometimes it will sound like fun and I will use it but never again will I let myself get addicted.
